scope: Docker container-start timeout distinct from MCP health failure

observed.daemon_evidence: Container inspection request cancelled by client with broken pipe at 05:58:10 UTC; container start completed after failure capture.

repair: Use max(configured client timeout, 90 seconds) for container start only. No automatic mutation retry; health verification remains required.

recovery.interpretation: Controlled retry succeeded. Memory restore gate withheld sovereign until rebuild completed. This does not prove the retry required more than the old 15-second startup timeout.
